description: The same file relabelled asset_class: industrial with no modules list - the misuse RFC 0003 exists to end, and the hospitality suite's relabelled-office twin. The module declares org.uwmd.data_center and enhances no builtin, so nothing runs: no calcs, no findings, and in particular no MOD-SECTION-MISSING for the dc_capacity block that is still physically present. Scope is part of the contract.
